description: This Java source file defines the class 'ThingModifyCommandAckRequestSetter', which is an immutable singleton class extending 'AbstractCommandAckRequestSetter'. It is responsible for checking and modifying 'ThingModifyCommand' objects to include acknowledgement requests if applicable, specifically handling the 'TWIN_PERSISTED' acknowledgement label.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandAckRequestSetter
classes.description: An immutable singleton class that extends AbstractCommandAckRequestSetter to set acknowledgement requests on ThingModifyCommand objects, specifically for the TWIN_PERSISTED label.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ThingModifyCommandAckRequestSetter.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Checks if the command is a ThingModifyCommand and applies header extension for acknowledgement; deprecated in favor of 'apply' method in the superclass.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines whether the given ThingModifyCommand is applicable for header extension, excluding live channel commands.

methods.name: getMatchedClass
methods.description: Returns the class object for 'ThingModifyCommand', used for type matching.

methods.name: isBindResponseRequiredToAddingRemovingImplicitLabel
methods.description: Overrides to specify that bind response is not required for adding or removing implicit labels.
